title: Ender Boost
description: This is a simple optimization modpack that ultimately boosts your FPS@#$
body:
Ender Boost is a carefully curated Minecraft modpack designed to maximize your frame rate and provide a smoother, more responsive gaming experience. By optimizing both client and server performance with a combination of advanced performance-enhancing mods, this modpack ensures you can enjoy Minecraft at higher settings without lag or stuttering, even on lower-end hardware. Key features of Ender Boost include:

Significant FPS improvement compared to the vanilla game, allowing you to experience smoother gameplay. Efficient resource management that minimizes memory and CPU usage. Compatibility with popular shaders and texture packs, so you don't have to sacrifice visual quality for performance. Easy installation and configuration, making it suitable for beginners and advanced users alike. Regular updates and maintenance to ensure maximum stability with the latest Minecraft versions.

Whether you're playing on an aging laptop or want to make the most out of your high-end PC, Ender Boost helps you get the best possible performance out of Minecraft. Discover the difference a highly optimized modpack can make and take your Minecraft experience to the next level!
